screens.title: 工作台
screens.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high-fidelity desktop application UI design screenshot, front-on flat digital UI, landscape 16:10, intended as an implementable visual concept for a township government customization of the Goose AI agent/harness. The three attached user screenshots are information-architecture references only: preserve sidebar destinations new conversation, recipes, skills, apps, schedules, extensions, history, settings; completely redesign the visuals. This requested asset is the HOME / WORKBENCH screen, not a collage, no device photography. Audience: Chinese township government officials, elegant, dignified, generous whitespace, restrained civic design. Design system shared for a series: light warm-white #F7F5F1 main canvas, white cards, very deep charcoal #252B32 typography, official dark vermilion #A52830 primary, restrained muted gold #B39A67 fine accents, thin warm-gray borders, 10 px corner radius, no glossy effects, no neon, no heavy gradients. A 238px LEFT white navigation sidebar with a small abstract civic building line-symbol (not national emblem) and Chinese brand '政务智办' and subtitle '镇政府智能工作台'. Full Chinese labels and crisp legible modern Chinese sans typography. Sidebar routes each with distinct thin line icon: '工作台' selected with pale red background and red vertical indicator, '配方中心', '技能中心', '应用中心', '任务调度', '扩展管理', '会话历史'. Sidebar bottom '设置' and signed-in account with neutral initials avatar '张', display name '张主任', role '党政办公室'. Top horizontal header breadcrumb '工作台' at left, subtle status '服务已连接', notification bell and small avatar right. Main content: modest red overline '政务协同 · 高效履职', large clear heading '上午好，张主任' and small date '2026年10月23日 星期五'. Large central conversational composer titled '今天需要处理什么工作？', placeholder '起草公文、查询政策、整理会议纪要…', attachment icon, microphone icon and strong red '开始办理' button. Composer footer small model pill '政务大模型' and '工作目录：政务文档'. Under it 4 evenly sized quick-action cards EACH with its own refined square ICON tile, title and short subtitle: '公文起草' / '通知、报告、请示规范生成', '政策查询' / '政策依据与条款快速检索', '会议纪要' / '整理要点，提取待办事项', '档案审核' / '材料核对与归档辅助'. Lower region a spacious '最近会话' compact 3-row list of sample government office tasks and a small '常用能力' panel with icon-led entries. Fictional task examples only, do not imply actual data or functioning login. Fine footer 'AI 生成内容请审核后使用'. Clear hierarchy, substantial practical reading size, professional public-sector desktop software, tasteful and calm, enough whitespace, production-quality UI visual. Render all text accurately. No watermarks, no official seals, no extraneous English headings.
